title: CodeGraph Copilot — Developer Infrastructure & Service Dependency Intelligence
highlights: Built a Java/Python developer platform combining AST-based static analysis, graph traversal, and PostgreSQL dependency modeling to detect risky service changes, missing instrumentation, unused APIs, and validation-rule violations.
Designed PostgreSQL schemas for files, symbols, call edges, dependency paths, build records, validation rules, and issue fingerprints, enabling structured service-impact and failure analysis.
Integrated AI-assisted diagnostics over deterministic analysis to generate root-cause summaries, dependency-impact explanations, test suggestions, and CI/CD debugging guidance.
